App.Title: MonitorSwitch Display Assistant
Display.Title: Displays
Display.Subtitle: Arrange your monitors, adjust resolution and refresh rate, then save the whole setup as a profile.

Profiles.Title: Profiles
Profiles.Subtitle: Save the current monitor arrangement and settings as a profile, then switch with one click from the tray or a hotkey.
Profiles.EmptyDesc: Click "New from current" in the top right to save your current monitor setup as a profile.
Settings.Title: Settings
Settings.Subtitle: Personalize how MonitorSwitch behaves.
Settings.ThemeDesc: Choose light, dark, or follow Windows
Settings.LanguageDesc: Choose the interface language, or follow Windows
Settings.AutoStartDesc: Run in the background after you sign in to Windows
Settings.StartMinimizedDesc: Stay in the system tray without showing the main window
Settings.CloseToTrayDesc: Keep running in the tray after closing the main window
